observer_contract.mechanism: One new pytest plugin, protocol hook wrapper per exact node, plus one bystander sampler thread per node. No sys.settrace, sys.setprofile, threading.settrace or threading.setprofile calls. Capture actual stack snapshots even when writer is inside frozen profile callback; do not rely on tracing callbacks being recursively traced.
observer_contract.lifecycle: In pytest_runtest_protocol before yielding setup, capture actual main ident/native_id and current sys/thread profile/trace identities, allocate own stop Event and one named non-daemon Thread. Start before the frozen fixture installs its profile. Do not clear/replace inherited hooks. Record hooks actually observed inside sampler and main before/after. Finally signal only own stop Event, join with <=2seconds inside the global cleanup15 allowance, record true alive/join/exception outcomes; failure to stop is incomplete, never silent.
observer_contract.inheritance: A sampler can inherit threading profile/trace at thread start. Record whether inherited identities match the captured originals; do not manufacture None. Unexpected installed hooks are retained and disclosed; no automatic hook replacement or probe. The observer's later threading.setprofile changes must not be disabled. No blanket exclusion from resource accounting.
observer_contract.reads: sys._current_frames only, actual main frame and at most one original writer frame chain for this node. Identify writer by pinned racefile and writer_body qualified code location (not a guessed thread name alone); confirm frame belongs to the original fixture. Never traverse arbitrary objects, deep copy locals, repr permissions, invoke runtime/repository/clock APIs, or acquire product locks.
observer_contract.primitive_projection: Read only pinned fixture _r223_run/observe_entry/writer_body/during_episode frame locals: exact dict case; boolean bootstrap_complete/writer_attempted/writer_returned/writer_joined if present; writer_exception type/message strings capped512 each; exact list order length and last8 primitive sequence/kind records. Barrier release,entered,ready,data.start,data.finished must be exact threading.Event instances; read existing __dict__['_flag'] only if exact bool, otherwise record unavailable/type-name (no coercion/property/method). No Event.is_set/wait/set/clear on product barriers. Diagnostic own stop Event methods are allowed.
observer_contract.frame_output: Per observed main/writer stack retain up to12 frames: filename<=512chars, co_qualname<=256chars, actual lineno; mark any truncation explicitly. No source text, f_globals dumps, arbitrary f_locals or authority payloads. Release all frame/frame-dict references in finally each tick, no frame objects in retained records.
observer_contract.sampling: Own stop.wait(0.25) between ticks; no busy loop. At most2401 ticks over the whole <=600second diagnostic, at most1024 serialized records per node and8MiB per-node JSON. Record changed stack/phase signature and at least one periodic unchanged observation per second while below bounds. Keep first/last sample, actual tick/record/dropped counters. Any cap/serialization/observation error means coverage incomplete, preserve obtained data, no retry.
observer_contract.time: perf_counter_ns only for host diagnostic offsets/durations; never passed to product or substituted for OC1, and not a claim of exact barrier timing. Samples are non-atomic, may miss intermediate states, and observer overhead perturbs scheduling.
observer_contract.schema: Each per-node sidecar: schema_version, exact_nodeid, pinned_sources, start/end host diagnostics, inherited_hooks, observed_thread_identity, samples, counters/bounds/dropped/observation_errors, sampler_resources, final_hook_comparison, complete. Each sample: ordinal/host_offset_ns/main_stack/writer_stack/primitive_state/barrier_flags/unavailable/truncation. No fabricated field when frame missing.
observer_contract.accounting: The additional three attempted sampler threads/own stop Events have their own actual constructor/start/ident/native_id/stop/join/alive/partial-init/error records. Actual count may be <3 if setup stops; do not prescribe observed totals. Do not merge them into, omit them from, or relabel the frozen resource sidecars. Frozen observer denominators are independently preserved; inherited-hook activity and any fixture-visible observation are reported, never double counted as the same object.
observer_contract.decision_output: For each node identify observed first/last main stack while writer release=false, observed writer wait/raise and later main stage, elapsed sampled intervals, missing intervals. If dominant phase cannot be distinguished, report unknown; do not translate a sampled stack into a proved root cause.
